events.symptom: The Followed list view renders a filled purple play button on every row (11 visible), plus a filled purple view toggle and filled page buttons, so accent no longer marks the primary or selected state.
events.acceptance: Row-level play controls are neutral at rest and use accent only on hover/focus; accent fill is limited to the selected view, the current page, and one primary action, with at most 3 filled-accent controls in the first viewport.

events.symptom: Faint text roles (section labels, card metadata, viewer counts) use 0.38-0.42 alpha white on #181818 at roughly 8.8-11px, measuring below 4.5:1 and straining the dense browsing surface.
events.acceptance: Every text role used for labels or values reaches at least 4.5:1 against its own surface at the 13px base size; decorative-only text is not used for information.

events.symptom: The stream card action menu trigger is 1.75rem (about 23px) with no expanded hit area, and several icon-only controls have no visible keyboard focus treatment.
events.acceptance: The menu trigger exposes at least a 40x40px effective hit area without covering the channel link, and every interactive control shows a visible focus-visible ring.

events.symptom: The Watching empty state is a single sentence inside a dashed box with no next action, although the page exists to manage active streams reached from browse.
events.acceptance: The empty state names the page task and offers exactly one clear action that leads to the streams browse page.

events.symptom: Two page-level titles compete: the thin 1.65rem route title in the toolbar and a bold 1.35rem tab heading at the top of the content column.
events.acceptance: One dominant page title remains; the in-content tab heading is subordinate in size and weight and does not compete as a second page title.

events.symptom: Stream cards identify channels only by name text, with no channel avatar, which slows recognition across a dense grid of 12+ live channels and removes a product-specific identity cue.
events.acceptance: Cards show the channel avatar when user data is available and a stable neutral fallback otherwise, while keeping the channel name plus the two required text lines under the thumbnail.

events.symptom: The empty state is dominated by a large purple search glyph while the input and Search button are already the primary action, adding a second accent focal point.
events.acceptance: The empty state uses neutral iconography and one action cue; accent stays on the primary search control.

events.symptom: The layout selector spans a full 28rem form row on an otherwise empty page, and the empty stream area only says that no streams exist without pointing at the add-channel path below.
events.acceptance: The layout control sits in a compact control column aligned with its label, and the empty stream area names the add/search action that fills it.

events.reason: Move repeated row play actions to a neutral rest state with accent on hover/focus; keep accent fill for the selected view and current page.
events.evidenceRef: docs/screenshots/design-refresh/followed-list-before.jpg vs followed-list-after.jpg; 11 row play buttons are neutral at rest; only the selected view toggle and current page keep accent fill.

events.reason: Raise the faint text token to 0.52 alpha in dark and #62626e in light, then measure the actual ratios.
events.evidenceRef: Computed contrast from src/styles/global.css: rgba(239,239,241,0.52) on #181818 = 5.01:1, on #202020 = 4.60:1, on #101010 = 5.37:1; light #62626e on #eef0f4 = 5.27:1.

events.reason: Keep the 2rem glyph visual, add a pseudo-element hit area only into the existing right/top/bottom gap, and add a global focus-visible rule for links, buttons and form controls.
events.evidenceRef: src/components/StreamActionsMenu.css: 2rem trigger with ::before inset -0.55rem -0.9rem -0.55rem -0.15rem yields a 48.8 x 49.6 CSS px effective hit area inside the card gap; focus ring captured in docs/screenshots/design-refresh/focus-visible.jpg.

events.reason: Add one task sentence and a single 'Browse Top streams' link to /streams.
events.evidenceRef: docs/screenshots/design-refresh/watching-after.jpg shows the single action; docs/screenshots/design-refresh/watching-link-verified.jpg shows the resulting /streams route after activating it.

events.reason: Reduce the in-content tab heading to 1.02rem/650 so the route title owns the page-level hierarchy.
events.evidenceRef: src/pages/SettingsPage.css: route title remains 1.45rem/600 while .settings__heading is 1.02rem/650; settings-before.jpg vs settings-after.jpg shows the single dominant title.

events.reason: Add the channel avatar from the already-fetched usersByLogin data with an initial fallback; keep the name, title, and meta lines intact.
events.evidenceRef: src/components/StreamGrid.tsx uses usersByLogin[login].profile_image_url with an initial fallback; followed-after.jpg shows avatars on all 12 visible cards with name + title + meta retained.

events.reason: Use the muted text color for the generic empty-state icon and keep accent only on the Search button.
events.evidenceRef: src/styles/global.css .empty-panel__icon now uses var(--text-muted); search-after.jpg shows a neutral glyph with accent retained on the Search button.

events.reason: Constrain the layout select to 18rem beside its label and name the search-and-add action in the empty copy.
events.evidenceRef: src/pages/MultistreamPage.css .ms-layout-row is a flex row with an 18rem select; src/locales/en/multistream.json currentEmpty names searching and adding a channel; multistream-before.jpg vs after shows the compact control and actionable copy.

events.symptom: Top streams shares the StreamGrid and shell surface used by Followed; the route was inspected after the shared card change for route-specific regressions.
events.acceptance: Top streams keeps the channel name plus two text lines, readable metadata, and at most one filled-accent primary control per viewport.

events.reason: The route uses the same StreamGrid component covered by RMX-DESIGN-001 and RMX-DESIGN-006; the 1280x880 render shows the updated cards with neutral row actions and no new defect.

events.symptom: The category grid is a separate repeated-unit surface from the stream cards and was inspected for consistency under the shared shell.
events.acceptance: Category cards keep readable names, viewer counts, and media-first focus without new accent or hierarchy regressions.

events.reason: The GameGrid already uses a media-first card with a 3:4 frame and restrained hover; the 1280x880 render shows no defect introduced by this pass.

events.symptom: The team lookup is a small idle/search surface that shares the shell and empty-panel primitives with the search route.
events.acceptance: The idle state remains legible and its primary control remains the single accent focal point.

events.reason: The route uses the same input and empty-panel primitives updated globally; the 1280x880 render shows a readable idle state with accent on the submit control only.

events.symptom: The About route carries connection status cards and setup diagnostics under the shared shell and typography.
events.acceptance: Status labels stay readable, equal comparison cards stay justified, and no new competing page title appears.

events.reason: The 1280x880 render keeps one page title, readable status text with the raised faint token, and equal cards for comparable connection states; no route-specific defect was found.

events.symptom: Followed hover, focus, and selected states reference the undefined custom properties --accent-line, --accent-soft, and --ring, so the stream-card outline, view-toggle selected fill, list play hover, and search focus ring silently lose their intended rendering.
events.acceptance: Every referenced interaction token resolves to a theme-appropriate value and the stream-card hover outline, view-toggle selected background, list play hover, and search focus ring render visibly in dark and light themes with no unresolved var() for these states.

events.symptom: Grid stream thumbnails have no visible watch affordance at rest or hover; the only intended hover response is a 1px accent outline that currently fails because its token is undefined.
events.acceptance: Hovering or keyboard-focusing a grid thumbnail reveals one neutral, non-obscuring watch cue with an accessible name, leaves the LIVE badge readable, and adds no resting accent fill.

events.symptom: In list view the stream thumbnail is only 3.7rem wide and carries a 0.52rem LIVE badge, making the preview and badge too small to recognize or read at 1280x880.
events.acceptance: List rows show a thumbnail at least 4.5rem wide with a legible or intentionally removed LIVE badge, while the streamer, title, game, viewers, runtime, and actions remain aligned and scannable at 1280x880.

events.symptom: Scrollable areas such as the Followed list and Multistream live strip expose bright native scrollbars that read as browser chrome rather than part of the dark app surface.
events.acceptance: Scrollbars use a thin neutral theme-aware thumb in dark and light modes, remain discoverable and operable, and cause no horizontal or vertical layout shift.

events.symptom: Hovering a row in Followed list view fills the entire row with solid accent purple because the invisible row-expand button inherits the global button hover background.
events.acceptance: Pointer hovering or keyboard-focusing a list row shows a subtle neutral surface change and a visible focus ring, never an accent-filled row; all row text and controls stay readable.

events.symptom: In the logged-out About render, the Manage connections login action fills the full card width with accent, competing with the sidebar login CTA as a second dominant primary action.
events.acceptance: The Manage connections action is a compact accent control aligned to the panel content start, remains clearly primary within its panel, and no longer spans the whole card.

events.symptom: The version line and View changelog sit on one row while Check for updates drops to a separate row, so update actions read as detached leftovers rather than one metadata toolbar.
events.acceptance: Version and all update-related actions share one aligned, wrapping toolbar on desktop and mobile; update status and error text remain below without duplicating controls.

events.symptom: In Interface settings the row title and its button both read 'Show setup wizard again', so the control repeats the setting name instead of stating the action it performs.
events.acceptance: The row keeps the setting name and the button uses a short action label that describes opening the wizard, still right-aligned in the settings row.

events.reason: Current list render keeps row play controls neutral at rest; the shared token repair restores their intended hover accent without reintroducing accent-filled rows.
The raised --text-faint token remains in current source and the inspected settings, about, streams and multistream renders keep labels legible.
The expanded action-menu hit area and global focus-visible rule remain; a keyboard-focused card shows the visible ring and watch cue.
StreamGrid still renders the fetched channel avatar with an initial fallback; the 1264 and 390 renders keep the channel name plus two text lines.

About was inspected at 1264x791 and 390x844: one page title, readable status labels, justified comparison cards, and no route-specific regression.
Define --accent-soft, --accent-line and --ring in :root so every intended interaction state resolves in both themes.
Add a neutral play cue on thumbnail hover/focus and a theme-aware accent outline; keep no resting accent.
Enlarge the list thumbnail to 4.6rem and remove the redundant sub-8px LIVE badge while preserving row alignment.
Theme the scrollbar thumb and track for WebView2 and Firefox while keeping a 10px operable target.
Keep the invisible row-expand button transparent on hover, focus and active so only the subtle row surface change remains.
Constrain the Manage connections login action to content width with align-self:flex-start.
Move version, changelog, update-check and install actions into one wrapping metadata toolbar.
Keep the setting name in the row and label the button with the action it performs: Open setup wizard.
